versions.changelog:
Initial release of 视频内容智能分析工具 with advanced video-to-text and content extraction features.

- Supports analyzing videos from major Chinese platforms like Douyin, Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, etc.
- Converts video/audio speech to clean, deduplicated text (Mandarin, Cantonese, other dialects and foreign languages supported).
- Allows custom prompts for content summary, rewriting, golden lines extraction, shot lists, translation, and more.
- Processes both online video links and local files; supports reusing past analysis results via task ID.
- Enhanced privacy: uploads only required files, deletes source videos after processing, and does not use files for training or external sharing.
- Requires personal API token from 官方官网 (https://www.guaikei.com) before use.
